upstreamContract.note: Gosling enforces the host obligations it owns (admission, execution, compaction marker, revocation on resume) in its runtime. It does not produce or validate the boundary companion document (_registry/schema/boundary.schema.json) and does not declare the evidence_authority_boundary_enforcement consumer capability. eabEquivalents maps upstream fixture ids to the Gosling runtime test that exercises the analogous host behavior; it is an analogy, not a claim that Gosling passes the upstream validator.
